title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 30, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $4,500.00 to
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 30, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $4,500.00 to
  support Olympic Community Police Station’s Baker to Vegas team, as set forth. [BPC #26-323]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: The Board is asked to approve a $4,500 donation to support the Olympic Community Police Station's Baker to Vegas team.
